model_correction_this_round.what: the composition of quality and trait bonuses
model_correction_this_round.old: multiplier = quality_factor * (1 + trait_bonus), so a Tier I emblem scored 0.10 of its stat
model_correction_this_round.new: multiplier = 1 + quality_bonus + net_trait_bonus, exactly as the client prints it
model_correction_this_round.evidence: all nine observed emblems reproduce to the digit; the old rule reproduced none
model_correction_this_round.consequence: the real multiplier range is about 1.1 to 2.6 rather than 0.09 to 3.15, so a banner reweights the stats far less violently than the pre-banner model assumed

operation_targeting.finding: The operation labels name their target position explicitly: 第一枚 (first), 最后一枚 (last), 随机一枚 (random). The previous round's open question about which emblem of a colour an operation hits is answered by the client's own wording.
operation_targeting.consequence: An operation on a colour the banner holds twice is now well defined, and a 'random' variant is distinguishable from a positional one.

duplicate_team_across_roles.finding: With Support assigned to Xtreme Gaming, the Core 'Change Team' chooser lists Xtreme Gaming normally: no grey-out, no lock, no duplicate warning. All 16 teams appear.
duplicate_team_across_roles.caveat: No team was clicked and no submission was made, so this is strong UI evidence and not a confirmed successful duplicate submission.
duplicate_team_across_roles.consequence: The distinct-team constraint is very likely slack. It no longer gates the order of moves. It was never binding at the optimum anyway: the joint optimum Xtreme / Yandex / LGD already uses three different organisations.

counterfactual_model_validation.finding: Before the reroll, the model enumerated the Vampiric branch as producing weights [1.60, 1.50, 1.40]. The client now displays 160% / 150% / 140% with trait lines +50% / -10% / +30%. The prediction was made in advance and matched exactly.
counterfactual_model_validation.why_it_matters: The nine-emblem check could in principle have been a fit. This one could not: it predicted a state that did not exist yet.

team_change_regenerates_banner.why: If changing a team also regenerates the War Banner, switching Core would put the current banner at risk. That banner is in the top 4 percent of random Core banners (12088 versus a random mean of 6729), so the expected loss from regeneration is about -5360 against a +1334 gain from the better team.
team_change_regenerates_banner.resolution: one token on the operator's TEST account: change any team there and see whether its banner survives. The target account must not be used for this.
